headline: Selection of a chairperson and secretary, an executive session on a confidential matter, and scheduling a future meeting.
summary: Members will select a chairperson and a secretary. They will also meet in two executive sessions on confidential matters and act on matters discussed in those sessions.
items: Executive session under Connecticut General Statutes § 1-225(f), § 1-82a(b) and § 7-148(a) to consider a confidential matter
Discussion and possible action on matter discussed in Executive Session
Second executive session under Connecticut General Statutes § 1-225(f), § 1-82a(b) and § 7-148(a) to consider a confidential matter
Discussion and possible action on matter discussed in second Executive Session
Discussion and possible action on scheduling a future meeting
location: Room 315, Wallingford Town Hall, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, Connecticut
transcript:
# BOARD OF ETHICS

## NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

## AND AGENDA

There will be a Special Meeting of the Board of Ethics of the Town of Wallingford on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. in Room 315 of the Wallingford Town Hall, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, Connecticut.

## AGENDA

1. Discussion and possible action on the selection of a Chairperson.
2. Discussion and possible action on the selection of a Secretary.
3. Executive Session pursuant to Connecticut General Statutes § 1-225(f), § 1-82a(b) and § 7-148(a) to consider a confidential matter.
4. Discussion and possible action on matter discussed in Executive Session.
5. Executive Session pursuant to Connecticut General Statutes § 1-225(f), § 1-82a(b) and § 7-148(a) to consider a confidential matter.
6. Discussion and possible action on matter discussed in Executive Session.
7. Discussion and possible action on scheduling a future meeting.
8. Adjournment

*In accordance with Title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act, individuals in need of auxiliary aids for effective communication in programs and services of the Town of Wallingford are invited to make their needs and preferences known to the ADA Compliance Coordinator at 203-294-2070 five days prior to the meeting.*
